italian-reading-8.title: GLI
italian-reading-8.subtitle: Listen and repeat familiar words
italian-reading-8.description: Recognize GLI in common words and practice its sound with audio.

ir8-p1.translations: The family prepares pasta. The son chops the garlic.

ir8-t1.text: In famiglia, figlio, aglio, the combination gli represents one sound.

ir8-t2.text: The sound is best learned by listening: hear the words and repeat without relying on approximate pronunciation guides.

ir8_q1.question: How should gli be read in the words from this lesson?

options.ir8_q1_opt2: As three separate sounds: G, L, and I

ir8_q2.question: How is "figlio" correctly divided into syllables?

ir8_q3.question: Which word contains the GLI combination?

ir8_q4.question: Which syllable division keeps GLI together?
